integrity: Original source qualitative and lower-period findings are credited; exact algebraic proof and self-contained symbolic checker are included. Finite sampled heights are not a proof of the all-height claim; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three complete supporting lines of a Euclidean isosceles triangle with half-base one; height strictly positive; ties fix the point. The result classifies only primitive five-cycles. It does not determine higher periods, global basins, or truncated-side models. Some unindexed equivalent priority remains possible.
title: Sharp fifth-period window for the isosceles farthest-projection map
